**Describe the bug**
The Lab section of the Eartquakes example has an error in the html. Most of the text appears in the same code snippet block.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to [QUARANTINED_URL: neomjs.com]
2.  scroll down to the lab at the bottom
3. Expand lab section
4. See error

**Expected behavior**
Doc should be formatted with mixed description/instruction sections and code snippet blocks.

**Screenshots**

!Image [QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]
